text_block_list.text:
A huge crowd gathers at the Japan Cup,
Mayano
Top Gun among them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан races the Emperor in her
mind
countless times... yet is unable to
see an outcome
where she defeats her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean she can't do it.
Her heart
races in anticipation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
